from.place: The field model in step 7 of the finite-etale lifting split, through Cartier equality; Explicit triangular field-model equations

title: Explicit triangular field-model equations
statement: Let $k$ be a commutative ring and let $d,r\geq0$. Write $R_j=k[X_0,\ldots,X_{j-1}]$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]. Given $h\in R_d$ and $p_i\in R_{d+1+i}[Z]$ for $0\leq i<r$, define a list $f$ in $R_{d+1+r}$: its first entry is $hX_d-1$, and its entry $i+1$ is $p_i(X_{d+1+i})$, embedding its coefficient ring by the inclusion of the first $d+1+i$ variables. Thus $f$ has length $r+1$. This is the explicit presentation with $T=X_d$ and $Y_i=X_{d+1+i}$.
